Percentages are calculated as each country's net sales divided by the total net sales across all countries in fiscal year 2025.
Results are rounded to 2 decimal places for readability.

WITH country_category_sales AS (
  SELECT
    s.country_code,
    p.category_en,
    SUM((f.gross_amount - f.discount_amount - f.vat_amount) / fx.eur_rate) AS net_sales_eur
  FROM fact_sales f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = f.store_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id
  JOIN fx_rate fx ON fx.rate_date = f.sales_date AND fx.currency = f.currency
  WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
    AND NOT s.is_test_store
    AND f.sales_date >= '2025-01-01'
    AND f.sales_date < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.country_code, p.category_en
),
ranked_sales AS (
  SELECT
    country_code,
    category_en,
    net_sales_eur,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC, category_en ASC) AS rn
  FROM country_category_sales
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  category_en,
  ROUND(net_sales_eur, 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY country_code, category_en;
